verdict.rationale: Jira docs mention Rovo AI for automations and AI-assisted status tracking, indicating a built-in AI assistant capability, but evidence is thin, vendor-only marketing copy with no independent/hands-on confirmation of delegating tasks to it. missing for 10: detailed documentation of Rovo AI's task-delegation scope, independent or community validation that it works as an in-product assistant, and specifics on how tasks are assigned/executed by the AI.
